story: In the diverse world of birds, the Green Backed Flycatcher (Dicrurus paradiseus) stands out. This species, part of the Dicruridae family, is a resident of moist deciduous forest; rainforest; lowland forest; montane forest; wooded areas. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Green Backed Flycatcher is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Green Backed Flycatcher and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
